cases.question: 已支付订单共有多少笔？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status=?

cases.question: 已取消订单共有多少笔？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status=?

cases.question: 已支付订单的总销售额是多少元？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid'

cases.question: 所有已取消订单的明细金额合计是多少元？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0, 2) AS cancelled_amount_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='cancelled'

cases.question: 已支付订单总共购买了多少件商品？按明细的quantity求和，不是统计明细条数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid'

cases.question: 按月份统计2026年1月至6月的已支付销售额（元），按月份升序列出。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

cases.question: 按地区统计已支付销售额（元），按销售额降序排列；金额相同时按地区名称升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY sales_yuan DESC, o.region ASC

cases.question: 按商品类别统计已支付销售额（元），按销售额降序排列并绘制柱状图；金额相同时按类别名称升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sales_yuan DESC, p.category ASC

cases.question: 按商品统计已支付销售额（元），列出商品编号、商品名称和金额，只包含有已支付订单明细的商品，按销售额降序、商品编号升序排列。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_yuan DESC, p.product_id ASC

cases.question: 已支付订单平均每笔销售额是多少元？包含金额为0的已支付订单，以订单数为分母，保留两位小数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS average_order_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid'

cases.question: 2026年1月已支付销售额合计多少元？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents), 0)/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<?

cases.question: 仅统计2026年1月31日这一天，已支付销售额是多少元？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents), 0)/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<?

cases.question: 2026年第一季度的已支付销售额合计多少元？按1月1日（含）到4月1日（不含）统计。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents), 0)/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<?

cases.question: 2026年7月有多少笔已支付订单，销售额合计多少元？没有订单时两个值都按0回答。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents), 0)/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<?

cases.question: 哪些商品没有出现在任何订单明细中？不区分订单状态，列出商品编号与商品名称，按商品编号升序。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i WHERE i.product_id=p.product_id) ORDER BY p.product_id

cases.question: 订单V2O0002中商品P001购买了几件，实际成交单价和明细金额分别是多少元？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT quantity, ROUND(unit_price_cents/100.0, 2) AS unit_price_yuan, ROUND(quantity*unit_price_cents/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM order_items WHERE order_id=? AND product_id=?

cases.question: 订单V2O0003的明细金额合计多少元？请保留两位小数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents), 0)/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM order_items WHERE order_id=?

cases.question: 订单V2O0004的订单状态是什么，明细金额合计多少元？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.status, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents), 0)/100.0, 2) AS sales_yuan FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_id=? GROUP BY o.order_id, o.status

cases.question: 2026年2月的已支付销售额相比1月增长了百分之多少？以1月为基期，百分数保留两位小数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)='2026-02' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)='2026-01' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END))*100.0/SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)='2026-01' THEN i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents ELSE 0 END), 2) AS growth_percent FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>=? AND o.order_date<?
